text:
incident-bot: :warning: ALERT: global router p99 jumped to ~3s, streaming connections showing long stalls. Auto-paging oncall. Reason hint: LB shard weight imbalance detected.

lena: I'm here. p95 ~450ms, but p99 sitting ~3s. Streaming stall traces show stalled chunks waiting on backend ack. Dash: https://dash.redwood/internal/streams?view=tail

chris: Checked ingress heatmap: eu-central-1 lb-pool-9 has sustained queue growth, CPU at 95% on shard-21. There's a correlated bump in cross-zone fallback traffic.

anika: Impact note for #oncall: customers may see intermittent streaming timeouts 5-20s then reconnects. No increase in 5xx rate. Marking impact = degraded tail latency for real-time gen.

lena: Searching router logs: many assignments to shard-21 even when hash would suggest shard-2. Example log snippet: `assign(req_id=..., hash=0x8b3)->shard-21 (mismatch)`. Looks like weight table not applied consistently across nodes.

chris: That aligns with a config rollout this morning: rollout id rr-2026-10 pushed affinity changes + weight adjustments. Maybe collision between controller replicas.

devops-bot: Recommended mitigation: https://runbooks.internal/router/drain-and-rollback. Key steps: 1) pause rollout 2) rollback to previous stable 3) drain hot shard 4) enable fallback routing.

anika: I'm pausing the rollout via controller UI now. Paused rr-2026-10 -> controller returned OK.

lena: Rolling back to stable policy (rp-stable-2026-08). Initiating rollback through controller API: `POST /controller/rollouts/rollback` payload referencing rp-stable-2026-08.

chris: While rollback starts, I'll bump capacity for lb-pool-9 by adding 2 replicas to the pool to absorb queued streams. Executing autoscaler patch.

anika: Enabled streaming fallback path to quantized-stream-model for affected routes to keep token flow while main path heals.

lena: After fallback and initial rollback, p99 dropped to ~1.2s within 3 minutes, p95 ~380ms. Streaming reconnects still seen but far fewer.

chris: Captured config diffs between controller and node-level tables. Found missing `affinity_override: true` on several nodes due to a templating bug in rollout generator.

lena: Taking shard-21 out of rotation: `routerctl drain shard-21 --grace 45s`. Confirming drain in progress.

anika: Customer impact: CS alerted; two enterprise customers in eu-central reported brief degraded sessions. Escalated to account teams.

devops-bot: Tip: to reduce retry storm, consider applying a 2s client-side retry-backoff via temporary feature flag for streaming endpoints.

chris: Implemented 3% traffic-shed on non-enterprise customers hitting streaming endpoints to reduce load while shard drains.

lena: Observability update: after drain p99 trending down to 740ms, p95 340ms. Queue depth on shard-21 drained to zero, node CPU back to normal.

anika: We'll keep eager fallback enabled until the generator fix is deployed. Creating ticket: INF-8792 "routing-rollout generator: affinity key bug" and assigning to tao.

tao: Acknowledged INF-8792. I'll triage generator template and add stronger validation to ensure `affinity_override` is set consistently across replicas.

lena: Snapshotting routing tables and checksums for postmortem: `curl controller.internal/routing/table | sha256sum > /tmp/4100056789-routing.sha256`. Uploading to S3 after.

chris: Traces and packet captures uploaded to s3://incidents/4100056789/captures/. Will attach to ticket and postmortem.

anika: Customer-success: drafted advisory for affected accounts, recommending they implement client-side retry jitter until we confirm full resolution.

lena: Handoff: I'm handing oncall to chris for verification window. I'll update incident doc with timeline and mitigations. Keep thread open until steady-state confirmed for 30m.

chris: Taking over. Monitoring for 30m. Initial 10m numbers: p99 760ms, p95 330ms, streaming stall rate dropped 92%.

tao: Quick patch landed to generator in staging to add a pre-flight config checksum and node sync check. Will propose staged deploy after postmortem.

anika: Postmortem owners: tao (generator fix), chris (LB autoscale improvements), lena (rollout gating + alerting). Adding action items to INF-8792.

customer-success: CS will reach out to impacted customers with timeline and remedial steps once postmortem is available.

chris: If p99 stays <1s for 30m I'll mark the incident resolved and start revert of temporary traffic-shed and eager fallback per runbook.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by lena, chris. Severity: SEV2.

chris: 30m update: p99 720ms, p95 310ms, streaming stalls negligible. Reverting traffic-shed now and scheduling generator patch rollout with canary gating.

anika: Noting revert tasks in ticket. Postmortem will include timeline, root cause (rollout generator template bug causing affinity inconsistency -> hot LB shard), mitigation steps, and long-term fixes.

lena: Closing handoff: leaving final notes in incident tracker and starting postmortem doc. Great work everyone. :raised_hands:
